infra-planner: Planning a short midnight micro-patch window to address a driver regression that intermittently increases GPU IO latency in us-east2. Target window: Thu 00:30
MT (04:300:30 UTC) for 3.5h. We'll do rack-by-rack rolling reboots, keep <=12% GPU capacity offline. Canary at start.

eli: Which pools are impacted? Any reserved/dedicated commitments we should avoid touching?

infra-planner: In-scope: us-east2-ai-pool-main (primary), us-east2-ai-pool-backup (spill). Dedicated tenants pinned to us-east2-dedicated-1 will remain; we won't drain those nodes. We will route burst traffic to eu-fallback and us-west warm pools if needed.

zoe: Canary details + warmup? KV cache concerns?

infra-planner: Canary = single rack in us-east2-ai-pool-main (rack-3), 00:30 local start, 25m. Steps: mark unschedulable -> graceful drain -> BMC reboot -> smoke tests (latency + IO throughput) -> begin cohort ramp. We'll pre-warm KV cache for top-500 prefixes and run a short kv-seed after each cohort for 50m.

infra-planner: Example drain command:
```
kubectl drain node-use2-rack3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```

pete: Cost/throughput effect? We need an estimate to pass to finance and product.

infra-planner: Estimated: p95 may move ~70ms for affected region during backfill; p50 ~2ms. Token-cost increase ~4% for affected traffic due to fallback models + cross-region egress. We'll enable 25% throttle on interruptible tenants and raise autoscale min replicas by +1 per pool to smooth.

lina: Monitoring noise? Alerts to suppress?

infra-planner: Suppress transient alarms: `egress-jitter-use2` (30m per cohort), `kv-hit-drop` (10m post-cohort). DO NOT suppress `gpu-temp`, `gpu-oom`, `node-unreachable`. Add a dashboard panel for cohort status and capacity slack.

infra-bot: preflight: driver patch validated on staging (perf delta <1%), no pending NIC firmware in us-east2, network baseline within normal.

oncall: I'll be present for canary. Please add runbook link and rollback steps to this thread.

infra-planner: Rollback plan: if canary sees >1.5% sustained IO error rate over 5m or p95 latency >20ms above baseline, abort and revert to previous driver using k8s Rollout. Fallback routing to eu/west will be triggered automatically via smart-router.

deploy-bot: Maintenance scheduled: maintenance/1774207890-use2-driver-micropatch (ETA 04:30 UTC).

eli: Will tenants in backfilled pools see model-variant changes? We should pin a lower-memory variant to reduce OOM incidents during the window.

infra-planner: Yes 
during cohorts we may route non-critical inference to v-lowmem-compact model variant. It has slightly higher latency but more stable memory footprint. We'll tag requests with route metadata for billing reconciliation.

pete: I'll send cost impact note to finance (estimates + duration). Also suggest enabling short-lived reserved bursts in us-west to keep SLAs for high-tier customers.

lina: For alerts: I'll prepare an alert playbook snippet showing which signals to ignore and a quick triage checklist for gpu temp/oom.

infra-planner: Owners/timeline:
- 04:00 UTC: final preflight (infra-planner + oncall)
- 04:30 UTC: canary cordon/drain (zoe + oncall)
- 04:55 UTC: canary smoke tests (eli)
- 05:10:30 UTC: staggered cohorts (pete + infra team)
- 07:50 UTC: final verification and unmute alerts (infra-planner)

oncall: ACK. Runbook link added to #release-war-room.

zoe: If we detect increased cross-region egress >10% of normal, pause cohorts and call a halt 
we should avoid unexpected billing spikes.

infra-planner: Agreed. Abort criteria also includes cross-region egress >10% sustained for 10m. We'll keep finance on standby and post an update if we hit 5% threshold.

eli: Small ask: can we pre-warm the model cache on eu fallback earlier (1h before) to reduce latency when failover happens?

infra-planner: Yes, schedule a prewarm job 1h before start for eu-fallback and us-west warm-pool.

pete: I'll coordinate with product for a brief status blurb. Keep it short: "Planned micro-patch, limited impact expected; some increased latency possible."

infra-planner: Great. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can attend.

eli: :thumbsup:

zoe: :thumbsup:

pete: :thumbsup:

oncall: Standing by.

infra-planner: Thanks all starting preflight at 04:00 UTC. Will post immediate updates here if anything changes.
